logline: On the La Liga podium, Mbappé and Yamal each try to show off with a penalty — both miss (as they really did this weekend), Raphinha takes the ball back, and their teams win anyway.

beats.idea: podium: Yamal top (Barça 36), Mbappé below (Real 33), Atlético 28 sad
Mbappé shoots a penalty at the trophy above Yamal — skied, flies off
Yamal shows how — shanks it off his ankle, it bonks Mbappé
Raphinha snatches the ball: 'MY BALL'; Flick may give pens back to Raphinha
points flip: Barça 36 (3-2 from 0-2), Real 33 (9 wins in a row); Atlético climbs
Mbappé and Yamal both run at the same ball; Raphinha scores into the trophy
they point at each other: worse miss?

twist: the one who scores is the player whose penalty was taken from him
callback: the trophy target from beat 2 is finally hit by Raphinha; Mbappé's skied ball falls back on his head at the end
hidden_details: the skied ball lands back at the end
meme_frame: Yamal's shank hitting Mbappé on the head
hook_frame0: Yamal on the top step holding a ball, Mbappé glaring up from below
